decisions.reason: Locked label is right. The DOI at cp 3094 sits in the مسار= (url=) field of the AAS citation, inside the publisher URL https://iopscience.iop.org/article/10.1088/0004-637X/741/2/68. 3.5's URL row covers resolver URLs and publisher URLs whose path contains /doi/; this path is /article/, so the 'anything else' row applies and the raw text is the identifier text, as locked. A DOI in url= that points at the article is identifier_link (the guide's own example). Key 10.1088/0004-637x/741/2/68 is right (ends before the space after '68'). The DOI= field (cp 3302) and the web.archive.org snapshot (cp 3242, not_a_target) are separate locked items.
